releases.summary: Close-time consumer_outcome_gate: `dontpanic plan close` runs a deterministic gate before the active->completed flip and can block a product-class / consumer-journey-bearing plan whose user-facing outcome is unproven on a real surface (plan 2026-06-14-002).

actions.title: Close-time consumer-outcome gate is now enforced
actions.detail: `dontpanic plan close` can now refuse to close (or flag) a product-class or consumer-journey-bearing plan whose user-facing outcome was not proven on a real surface. This is enforced at plan close, not as an operator migration -- no command is required after pulling.
actions.human_next_step: No action needed. The gate runs automatically inside `dontpanic plan close`.

releases.summary: Evidence typing vocabulary: shared closed enums an EvidenceRef can carry -- surface_class, evidence_class, consumer_family, data_provenance, availability, degraded_mode -- plus a typing rule (`check_journey`) for which evidence classes a surface + claim kind requires (plan 2026-06-15-001).

actions.title: Evidence typing vocabulary is available
actions.detail: EvidenceRefs can now carry the shared evidence-typing enums; fail-closed enforcement applies to agent-family surfaces today, while a human surface lacking the structured fields is `not_yet_typed` rather than invalid. Nothing to run on upgrade.

releases.summary: Degraded-honesty + cross-surface agreement checker: verifies that when a required data source is down every declared family degrades honestly (an explicit availability=unavailable signal), and the human-vs-agent views for the same (objective, data_source) agree (plan 2026-06-15-002).

actions.title: Degraded-honesty + cross-surface agreement checker added
actions.detail: `check_degraded_honesty` now verifies honest degradation when a required data source is down, and that human-vs-agent views for the same objective agree. Enforced at plan close -- no operator command is required after pulling.

releases.summary: Usage-driven canonical-repo discovery: the ledger writer captures canonical_repo at invocation time, a one-time backfill reconciles historical records, and `dontpanic projects discover --json` surfaces the metadata-only discovery contract (plan 2026-06-17-001).

actions.title: Backfill canonical-repo discovery for tracked projects
actions.detail: Canonical-repo discovery records the durable project identity at invocation time. Projects tracked before this release have no canonical_repo until a one-time backfill reconciles their historical invocation-ledger records.

commands.label: preview
commands.description: Preview the backfill: shows which tracked projects would gain a canonical_repo, mutating nothing.

commands.label: apply
commands.description: Apply the one-time backfill, writing canonical_repo for confirmed historical records.

commands.label: verify
commands.description: Verify discovery now reports the canonical projects.

actions.success_message: Tracked projects are reconciled into canonical-repo discovery; `dontpanic projects discover --json` reports them.
actions.failure_message: Canonical-repo discovery backfill is still pending: tracked projects have no canonical_repo yet.
actions.human_next_step: Run the preview, then apply the backfill, then re-run `dontpanic doctor --upgrade` to confirm the probe clears.
